chose: draw.ts generic over {recipeId:string} instead of importing RandomizerCard
because: that type is another in-flight agent's work and did not exist in api/types.ts at write time (grepped, zero hits); generic keeps draw.ts buildable/testable without a dependency on landing order

chose: unified draw()+reroll() into one draw(pool, excludeRecipeId, rng) function
because: spec 5.1/5.2/5.3 describe the same uniform-pick-with-optional-exclusion operation; two functions would duplicate the pickIndex/no-repeat logic for one real difference (whether excludeRecipeId is null), so one caller-facing entry point stayed tight per the count-instances rule

chose: excluded RandomizerFilters.source from hasActiveFilters/countSheetFilters, and clearFilters() preserves it
over: treating source as a filter that Clear filters/hasActiveFilters also reset or count
because: spec section 4.1 groups source under a // scope comment separate from the filter fields, and section 4.5's widen-to-corpus is documented as its own affordance with its own rolls-immediately behavior, distinct from the Clear filters button in 5.5/6.3; resetting scope on Clear would silently un-widen someone mid-browse

chose: slotForHour: floor+modulo wrap for out-of-range, explicit NaN/non-finite guard returns snack
over: clamping out-of-range hours to 0 or 23, or throwing on NaN
because: spec 8 requires a total function with an explicit documented policy; floor+modulo treats 24/-1 etc as wrapped clock hours rather than saturating at a boundary slot, and NaN/Infinity would otherwise propagate through the modulo and silently fail every comparison, so it is caught first and mapped to the neutral non-mealtime snack slot rather than defaulting to breakfast or dinner

chose: no new invariant for patch c9a5343437868cdf
over: add an invariant or boundary claim that the change does not require
because: new pure module with no consumers wired up yet (UI/server slice land separately); its correctness properties (pickIndex never returns out-of-bounds even for a hostile rng=1, no-repeat never empties the candidate set, clearFilters/hasActiveFilters read one shared defaultFilters source) are pinned as concrete unit assertions in draw.test.ts and week.test.ts rather than a repo-wide anchor, since nothing outside this module yet relies on the contract
